name: test-gate
# Canonical repository-local Test Gate (rubio-standards ADR-0020). Replaces the
# retired bespoke `test.yml`.
#
# The old workflow drove both runners from a `strategy.matrix`; the contract
# forbids matrices in this file (a matrix leg that never starts is
# indistinguishable from one that passed), so each runner is now an explicit
# job carrying the full execution proof, and both are listed in the aggregate's
# `needs`.
#
# `make test` is a thin dispatcher onto `bash tests/run.sh` — see the Makefile
# for why the harness is not invoked directly here.

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

# Least-privilege default for the GITHUB_TOKEN: tests don't need write scope.
permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  tests-ubuntu:
    name: tests / ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    # Runner selection uses the org-level RUNNERS map so the fleet can move
    # between GitHub-hosted and self-hosted pools centrally. The per-key
    # fallback preserves this job's previous GitHub-hosted label.
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').small || fromJSON('["ubuntu-slim"]') }}
    outputs:
      tests_ran: ${{ steps.test.outputs.tests_ran }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      # Pin Node to a specific patch so setup-node@v6 can't drift across runs.
      # Coverage collection uses NODE_V8_COVERAGE which has been stable since
      # Node 18, but a fixed version keeps the coverage gate deterministic.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: "24.22.0"

      # jq is bundled with both runner images at compatible versions. We pin
      # shellcheck explicitly because new releases periodically add diagnostics
      # that would otherwise flip the suite from green to red without any code
      # change. Identical binary on both OSes.
      - name: install shellcheck (pinned)
        env:
          SHELLCHECK_VERSION: v0.10.0
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          url="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/releases/download/${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}/shellcheck-${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}.linux.x86_64.tar.xz"
          tmp=$(mktemp -d)
          curl -fsSL "$url" | tar -xJ -C "$tmp"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin"
          install -m 0755 "$tmp/shellcheck-${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}/shellcheck" "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/shellcheck"
          rm -rf "$tmp"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify baked jq
        run: jq --version

      - name: print tool versions
        run: |
          bash --version | head -1
          node --version
          jq --version
          shellcheck --version | head -2

      - id: test
        name: run test suite
        # The harness prints a `PASS: <n> tests, 0 failures` summary line on a
        # green run; that <n> is the executed-test COUNT the gate asserts is
        # non-zero. Piping through tee keeps the log on the job output while
        # `set -o pipefail` still propagates a red suite.
        env:
          RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/test-gate-count
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -f "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          make test | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-run.log"
          awk '/^PASS: [0-9]+ tests/{print $2}' "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-run.log" > "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          test -s "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          test "$(cat "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT")" -gt 0
          echo "tests_ran=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  tests-macos:
    name: tests / macos
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').macos || fromJSON('["macos-26"]') }}
    outputs:
      tests_ran: ${{ steps.test.outputs.tests_ran }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: "24.22.0"

      # shellcheck's darwin.x86_64 binary runs under Rosetta on arm64 runners;
      # switch to darwin.aarch64 once published for the version we pin.
      #
      # Installed into a runner-writable prefix on $GITHUB_PATH rather than
      # `sudo mv`-ed into /usr/local/bin: passwordless sudo and a writable
      # /usr/local/bin are GitHub-hosted-image properties, and the macos route
      # may point this job at a self-hosted pool where neither holds.
      - name: install shellcheck (pinned)
        env:
          SHELLCHECK_VERSION: v0.10.0
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          url="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/releases/download/${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}/shellcheck-${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}.darwin.x86_64.tar.xz"
          tmp=$(mktemp -d)
          curl -fsSL "$url" | tar -xJ -C "$tmp"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin"
          mv "$tmp/shellcheck-${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}/shellcheck" "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/shellcheck"
          chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/shellcheck"
          rm -rf "$tmp"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      # jq ships with the GitHub-hosted macOS image but is not guaranteed on a
      # self-hosted pool, and `brew` itself may be absent there. Install only
      # when jq is genuinely missing, and fail with a legible message rather
      # than a `brew: command not found` if it cannot be provided.
      - name: install jq
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "jq already present: $(command -v jq)"
            exit 0
          fi
          if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "jq is missing and Homebrew is unavailable on this runner" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          brew install jq

      - name: print tool versions
        run: |
          bash --version | head -1
          node --version
          jq --version
          shellcheck --version | head -2

      - id: test
        name: run test suite
        env:
          RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/test-gate-count
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -f "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          make test | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-run.log"
          awk '/^PASS: [0-9]+ tests/{print $2}' "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-run.log" > "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          test -s "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          test "$(cat "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT")" -gt 0
          echo "tests_ran=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  aggregate:
    name: test-gate
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [tests-ubuntu, tests-macos]
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').small || fromJSON('["ubuntu-slim"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
    steps:
      - name: Require successful non-empty test execution
        run: >-
          jq -e 'length > 0 and all(.[]; .result == "success" and
          .outputs.tests_ran == "true")' <<<"$NEEDS_JSON"

#
#   https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web#setup-scripts-vs-sessionstart-hooks

#      a cloud plugin pre-seed health NOTE (5b) when a carrier-declared
#      marketplace or an enabled plugin's cache copy is missing from the
#      snapshot (silent locally and during the snapshot build itself).

if [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" = "true" ] && [ -z "${CLOUD_SETUP_BUILD:-}" ] &&

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# @generated by rubio-standards. Update through Copier; do not edit the consumer copy.
# Source: Rubio-Enterprises/standards, template/scripts/common/standards-pin.sh

standards_pin_error() {
  printf 'standards pin: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  return 1
}

standards_pin_valid() {
  [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || standards_pin_error "expected a non-empty 40-character lowercase SHA"
}

standards_pin_record() {
  local workspace_key root
  root="$(cd -- "$1" && pwd -P)" || return 1
  workspace_key="$(printf '%s' "$root" | git hash-object --stdin)" || return 1
  printf '%s/standards/cloud/%s.pin\n' "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}" "$workspace_key"
}

standards_verify_checkout() {
  local root="$1" pin="$2" checkout="$1/.standards-config"
  standards_pin_valid "$pin" || return 1
  if [ -L "$checkout" ] || [ ! -d "$checkout/.git" ]; then
    standards_pin_error "$root needs a real .standards-config Git clone"
    return 1
  fi
  local origin shallow head dirty
  origin="$(git -C "$checkout" config --get remote.origin.url)" || return 1
  shallow="$(git -C "$checkout" rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" || return 1
  head="$(git -C "$checkout" rev-parse HEAD)" || return 1
  dirty="$(git -C "$checkout" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || return 1
  if [ "$origin" != 'https://github.com/Rubio-Enterprises/standards.git' ] ||
    [ "$shallow" != false ] || [ "$head" != "$pin" ] || [ -n "$dirty" ]; then
    standards_pin_error "checkout must be clean, full-history, at the expected pin, with the credential-free origin"
    return 1
  fi
}

standards_restore_pin() {
  local root="$1" record expected
  record="$(standards_pin_record "$root")" || return 1
  if [ "${STANDARDS_PIN+x}" != x ] && [ ! -e "$record" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  if [ "${STANDARDS_PIN+x}" = x ]; then
    standards_pin_valid "$STANDARDS_PIN" || return 1
  fi
  if [ -e "$record" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "$record" ] || [ -L "$record" ]; then
      standards_pin_error "provisioner record must be a regular file"
      return 1
    fi
    expected="$(<"$record")"
    standards_pin_valid "$expected" || return 1
    if [ "${STANDARDS_PIN+x}" = x ] && [ "$STANDARDS_PIN" != "$expected" ]; then
      standards_pin_error "environment pin disagrees with the independent provisioner record"
      return 1
    fi
  else
    expected="$STANDARDS_PIN"
  fi
  standards_verify_checkout "$root" "$expected" || return 1
  export STANDARDS_PIN="$expected"
  if [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ]; then
    printf 'export STANDARDS_PIN=%s\n' "$STANDARDS_PIN" >>"$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" || return 1
  fi
}

standards_reader_git() {
  # Keep the token in the credential subprocess environment, never Git config
  # shellcheck disable=SC2016
  GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git \
    -c credential.helper= \
    -c credential.useHttpPath=true \
    -c http.extraHeader= \
    -c http.https://github.com/.extraHeader= \
    -c 'credential.helper=!f() { if [ "$1" = get ]; then printf "%s\n" "username=x-access-token" "password=$GH_PAT"; fi; }; f' \
    "$@"
}

standards_provision_pin() (
  set -euo pipefail
  local root="$1" url='https://github.com/Rubio-Enterprises/standards.git' pin record scratch
  if [ "${STANDARDS_PIN+x}" = x ]; then
    standards_pin_valid "$STANDARDS_PIN"
  fi
  if [ -z "${GH_PAT:-}" ]; then
    standards_pin_error 'the trusted cloud Setup-script must supply its existing read-only GH_PAT'
    exit 1
  fi
  local mise_bin
  if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" ]; then
    mise_bin="$HOME/.local/bin/mise"
  elif command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mise_bin="$(command -v mise)"
  else
    (cd / && curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh >/dev/null)
    mise_bin="$HOME/.local/bin/mise"
  fi
  test -x "$mise_bin"
  pin="$(standards_reader_git ls-remote --exit-code "$url" refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')"
  standards_pin_valid "$pin"
  if [ "${STANDARDS_PIN+x}" = x ] && [ "$STANDARDS_PIN" != "$pin" ]; then
    standards_pin_error 'supplied pin disagrees with independently resolved main'
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -e "$root/.standards-config" ] || [ -L "$root/.standards-config" ]; then
    # Refuse to destroy edits or an unrelated checkout while refreshing a snapshot
    standards_verify_checkout "$root" "$(git -C "$root/.standards-config" rev-parse HEAD)"
  fi
  scratch="$(mktemp -d "$root/.standards-provision.XXXXXX")"
  local installed=false had_previous=false complete=false record_temp=''
  trap '
    if [ "$complete" != true ] && [ "$installed" = true ]; then
      rm -rf "$root/.standards-config"
    fi
    if [ "$complete" != true ] && [ "$had_previous" = true ]; then
      mv "$scratch/previous" "$root/.standards-config"
    fi
    [ -z "$record_temp" ] || rm -f "$record_temp"
    rm -rf "$scratch"
  ' EXIT
  standards_reader_git clone --no-checkout "$url" "$scratch/checkout"
  git -C "$scratch/checkout" checkout --detach "$pin"
  mv "$scratch/checkout" "$scratch/.standards-config"
  standards_verify_checkout "$scratch" "$pin"
  if [ -d "$root/.standards-config" ]; then
    mv "$root/.standards-config" "$scratch/previous"
    had_previous=true
  fi
  mv "$scratch/.standards-config" "$root/.standards-config"
  installed=true
  STANDARDS_PIN="$pin" "$mise_bin" trust "$root/.mise.toml"
  STANDARDS_PIN="$pin" "$mise_bin" -C "$root" bootstrap repos status --missing
  record="$(standards_pin_record "$root")"
  umask 077
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$record")"
  record_temp="$(mktemp "$(dirname "$record")/.pin.XXXXXX")"
  printf '%s\n' "$pin" >"$record_temp"
  mv "$record_temp" "$record"
  complete=true
)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Check/install vtsls for Claude Code LSP plugin

BINARY="vtsls"
FORMULA="vtsls"
NPM_PACKAGE="@vtsls/language-server"

# Every plugin launches its server through the Node proxy (lsp-proxy.js), so a
# usable session needs node on PATH even when the server binary is present.
if ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[$BINARY] node is required to run this plugin's LSP proxy but is not on PATH." >&2
  echo "[$BINARY] Install Node.js (e.g. brew install node), then restart the session." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null; then
  exit 0
fi

# Determine install method: Homebrew first, npm fallback
if command -v brew &>/dev/null; then
  INSTALL_METHOD="brew"
  LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-brew.lock"
elif command -v npm &>/dev/null; then
  INSTALL_METHOD="npm"
  LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-npm.lock"
else
  echo "[$BINARY] Neither Homebrew nor npm found. Install one of them first."
  exit 1
fi

LOCK_TIMEOUT=120

do_install() {
  if [ "$INSTALL_METHOD" = "brew" ]; then
    echo "[$BINARY] Installing via Homebrew..."
    if brew install "$FORMULA"; then
      echo "[$BINARY] Installed successfully"
    else
      echo "[$BINARY] brew install failed"
      return 1
    fi
  else
    echo "[$BINARY] Installing via npm..."
    if npm install -g "$NPM_PACKAGE"; then
      echo "[$BINARY] Installed successfully"
    else
      echo "[$BINARY] npm install failed"
      return 1
    fi
  fi
}

# Serialized install (flock with mkdir fallback for macOS)
if command -v flock &>/dev/null; then
  (
    flock --timeout "$LOCK_TIMEOUT" 9 || {
      echo "[$BINARY] Lock timeout"
      exit 1
    }
    command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null && exit 0
    do_install
  ) 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
else
  waited=0
  while ! mkdir "$LOCK_FILE.d" 2>/dev/null; do
    if ((waited >= LOCK_TIMEOUT)); then
      echo "[$BINARY] Lock timeout"
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 2
    ((waited += 2))
  done
  trap 'rmdir "$LOCK_FILE.d" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
  command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null || do_install
fi

if ! command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[$BINARY] Not in PATH after install. Install manually: brew install $FORMULA"
  exit 1
fi

tests-ubuntu:

    timeout-minutes: 15

    # between GitHub-hosted and self-hosted pools centrally. The per-key
    # fallback preserves this job's previous GitHub-hosted label.
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').small || fromJSON('["ubuntu-slim"]') }}
    outputs:
      tests_ran: ${{ steps.test.outputs.tests_ran }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      # Pin Node to a specific patch so setup-node@v6 can't drift across runs.
      # Coverage collection uses NODE_V8_COVERAGE which has been stable since
      # Node 18, but a fixed version keeps the coverage gate deterministic.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          node-version: "24.22.0"

      # jq is bundled with both runner images at compatible versions. We pin
      # shellcheck explicitly because new releases periodically add diagnostics
      # that would otherwise flip the suite from green to red without any code
      # change. Identical binary on both OSes.
      - name: install shellcheck (pinned)
        env:
          SHELLCHECK_VERSION: v0.10.0
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          url="https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/releases/download/${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}/shellcheck-${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}.linux.x86_64.tar.xz"
          tmp=$(mktemp -d)
          curl -fsSL "$url" | tar -xJ -C "$tmp"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin"
          install -m 0755 "$tmp/shellcheck-${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}/shellcheck" "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/shellcheck"
          rm -rf "$tmp"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify baked jq
        run: jq --version

      - name: print tool versions
        run: |
          bash --version | head -1
          node --version
          jq --version
          shellcheck --version | head -2

      - id: test
        name: run test suite
        # The harness prints a `PASS: <n> tests, 0 failures` summary line on a
        # green run; that <n> is the executed-test COUNT the gate asserts is
        # non-zero. Piping through tee keeps the log on the job output while
        # `set -o pipefail` still propagates a red suite.
        env:
          RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/test-gate-count
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -f "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          make test | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-run.log"
          awk '/^PASS: [0-9]+ tests/{print $2}' "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-run.log" > "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"

      # shellcheck's darwin.x86_64 binary runs under Rosetta on arm64 runners;
      # switch to darwin.aarch64 once published for the version we pin.
      #
      # Installed into a runner-writable prefix on $GITHUB_PATH rather than

      # may point this job at a self-hosted pool where neither holds.

          SHELLCHECK_VERSION: v0.10.0

          tmp=$(mktemp -d)

          chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/shellcheck"

      # self-hosted pool, and `brew` itself may be absent there. Install only
      # when jq is genuinely missing, and fail with a legible message rather
      # than a `brew: command not found` if it cannot be provided.

          set -euo pipefail

            exit 1
          fi
          brew install jq

      - name: print tool versions
        run: |
          bash --version | head -1
          node --version
          jq --version
          shellcheck --version | head -2

      - id: test
        name: run test suite
        env:
          RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/test-gate-count
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -f "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          make test | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-run.log"
          awk '/^PASS: [0-9]+ tests/{print $2}' "$RUNNER_TEMP/test-run.log" > "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          test -s "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT"
          test "$(cat "$RUBIO_TEST_GATE_COUNT_OUTPUT")" -gt 0
          echo "tests_ran=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

aggregate:
    name: test-gate
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [tests-ubuntu, tests-macos]
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').small || fromJSON('["ubuntu-slim"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
    steps:
      - name: Require successful non-empty test execution
        run: >-
          jq -e 'length > 0 and all(.[]; .result == "success" and
          .outputs.tests_ran == "true")' <<<"$NEEDS_JSON"
